question: What proportional width should the flag have relative to the flagstaff measure?
premises: The flagstaff measure serves as the standard.
The length is taken as the reference dimension.
The width is set at an eighth part.
inference: The flag's width should be one-eighth of the flagstaff's measure in length.
plain_english: By the measure of the flagstaff, the flag's width should be one-eighth of its length.
